items.label: Monthly loss, home bags
items.source: Team to source. Check the Agricultural Household Survey 2024 first. Hinga Weze reports that poor handling loses 15–30% of output overall. That is not a monthly storage rate, so it is not used here.

items.label: Monthly loss, hermetic bags
items.source: Team to source. Check the Agricultural Household Survey 2024 first, then a published trial.

items.label: Fee, home bags
items.source: Home storage has no warehouse fee.

items.label: Fee, hermetic bags
items.source: Hermetic bags have no warehouse fee. The bag cost is a separate line.

items.label: Warehouse fee
items.source: Older EAX figure of 2.5% of value, reported by The New Times. The team should confirm the current rate.

items.label: Home bag cost
items.source: Team to source a local bag and handling cost.

items.label: Hermetic bag cost
items.source: Team to source a local supplier price, per kg stored.

items.label: Warehouse handling cost
items.source: Left blank. The 2.5% fee is already a share of value. A separate handling cost is not published in the sources used here.

items.label: Share of value borrowed, home bags
items.source: Home bags do not pay a loan up front.

items.label: Share of value borrowed, hermetic bags
items.source: Hermetic bags do not pay a loan up front.

items.label: Share of value borrowed, warehouse receipt
items.source: EAX warehouse-receipt loans of up to 70% of the value of stored grain, through Ecobank.

items.label: Annual interest rate
items.source: Team to source from a SACCO or partner bank. Required before the warehouse option can be priced, because the borrowed share is 70%.

items.label: Minimum likely gain
items.source: Starting threshold from the Hunika build guide. Tune on training years only, before looking at the latest season.

items.label: Maximum low-case loss
items.source: Starting threshold from the Hunika build guide. The low case may not be worse than this share of the sell-now value.

items.label: Stale price warning
items.source: Product rule in the Hunika build guide.

items.label: Years before a market stands alone
items.source: Model v1 rule in the Hunika build guide. Fewer years and the market is blended with its province.
